newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 2.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Dec 2.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Market rumours continue to swirl in the bank sector with traders speculating that National Australia Bank may launch a bid for Advance Bank to build a blocking stake to stall its merger with St George Bank. Rumours also circulate that Westpac could launch a bid for the Bank of Melbourne this week.
The head of News Corp's Australian operations said on Sunday that a takeover of newspaper group John Fairfax was no longer on the agenda for the global media group.
Macquarie Bank announces half year net profit of A$46.03 million.
Discovery said on Monday Premier Oil Plc had lifted its bid for Discovery to 81 cents per share from its previous offer of 80 cents per share.

Argyle Diamond Mines managing director Gordon Gilchrist said on Sunday a decision over the extension of the life of the Argyle diamond mine has been put off until at least the middle of next year, the Australian newspaper reported.
